item.title: Intergenerational Celebration Highlights Future of Northumberland’s Libraries
item.description: Northumberland County Council has marked World Book Day with a heartwarming intergenerational celebration as it launches a consultation asking residents to help shape the future of their libraries. item.title: Yorkshire recruiter TSA hands ownership and profit share to employees
item.description: Yorkshire-based recruitment and people solutions specialist TSA Surveying has marked its first full year as an Employee-Owned Trust (EOT) by paying a profit-share bonus to its team. The move, initiated on March 7th last year, sees the surveying and property recruitment firm transfer 100% of its ownership into a trust held for the benefit of its employees. […]

item.title: Volvo Cars is expanding production to meet strong EX60 demand
item.description: Volvo Cars is increasing 2026 production volumes for its fully electric EX60 SUV, on the back of strong customer demand for the car in its home market of Sweden and other key markets such as Germany. Barely a month after the car’s public reveal, nearly all major European markets are reporting retail orders considerably higher than internal forecasts.
